title: Scrub Bearer Tokens and OpenRouter Keys in Log Sanitizer
description: sanitizeLogs leaves OpenRouter API keys and Authorization Bearer tokens exposed in log strings.
taskPrompt: In src/sanitizer.js, extend sanitizeLogs to redact OpenRouter API keys (matching sk-or-v1-[a-zA-Z0-9]+) with '[REDACTED_API_KEY]' and Authorization Bearer tokens (matching /Bearer\\s+[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/gi) with 'Bearer [REDACTED_TOKEN]', while preserving existing GitHub token redaction.
